author: mmusich
body:
#### PR description:

Title says it all, with the integration of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51669 we can retire  `HLTP2GTTauFilter` as it is superseded by the more general `HLTP2GTSingleObjectFilter`.

#### PR validation:

- `cmssw` compiles.
- `runTheMatrix.py -l ph2_hlt -i all --ibeos` runs fine.
- Bitwise trigger results compatibility to be tested by the bot.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

N/A
title: replace `HLTP2GTTauFilter` with an instace of `HLTP2GTSingleObjectFilter`
